method: Ratios are median RadixRun time / median matched hash time. Geometric means are equal-weight per query within each family. Near parity means ratio in [0.9,1.1], not a statistical equivalence test. Provider change requires emitted RadixRun constructor sites, absent in the hash configuration; every changed pair also reduces measured hash computations. No-op pairs have no RadixRun build sites and equal hash computations. Materialized pairs are compared only to each other, not default.

import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
bench = root / 'features/workloads/target/bench'
report = json.loads((bench / 'tpch-1-index-comparison.json').read_text())
out = root / 'target/mac-broad-provider-inspection/expanded'
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
provenance = {}
paths = []
for query in report['queries']:
    name = query['query']
    crate = bench / 'crates' / name
    path = out / (name + '.rs')
    command = ['cargo', 'rustc', '--release', '--locked', '--offline', '--manifest-path', str(crate / 'Cargo.toml'), '--target-dir', str(root / 'target/tpch-workers'), '--', '-Zunpretty=expanded']
    with path.open('w') as source, path.with_suffix('.log').open('w') as log:
        subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, env=dict(os.environ, RUSTC_BOOTSTRAP='1'), stdout=source, stderr=log, check=True)
    provenance[name] = {'command':command, 'expanded_source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'timing_worker_sha256':hashlib.sha256((crate/'timing-worker').read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'configurations':[c['configuration'] for c in query['configs']]}
    paths.append(str(path))
subprocess.run(['cargo','build','--release','--offline','--manifest-path',str(root/'target/mac-broad-provider-inspection/Cargo.toml')],cwd=root,check=True)
inspector = root/'target/mac-broad-provider-inspection/target/release/inspect-providers'
result = subprocess.check_output([str(inspector), *paths],text=True)
(out/'provider-builds.json').write_text(result)
(out/'provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps(provenance,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Parsed generated Rust for',len(paths),'queries; captured concrete provider construction sites.')
